kitDescription: Poli (Treasure) is a Water shotgun Defender whose kit is almost entirely team protection, with two offensive auras. Every 5 shots she raises all allies' ATK by 5.46% for 10 seconds, which in practice stays up nearly permanently, and at battle start she gains the Police Badge, a self-shield equal to her full Max HP for 10 seconds. Every 20 seconds she raises the DEF of herself and the two most wounded allies by 23.51% for 10 seconds and shares incoming damage with them, and when the Badge ends she heals herself over 5 seconds. Her burst grants the whole team ATK +44.55% for 10 seconds and a shared shield equal to 40% of her Max HP for 10 seconds; if the Badge is still up when she bursts she instead gains Indomitability and consumes the Badge. In a damage sim without incoming boss damage, only the two ATK buffs and her burst-gauge generation move the board.

Both nearest-wrong models (fullBurstEnter over-credit, badge-gate under-credit) are pinned RED.

verdictRationale: No real gotchas: all 8 kit lines are FAITHFUL (5) or DOCUMENTED_GAP (3), and every gap carries a recorded reason plus, where material, an estimate/recipe/tier (⚑1 badge-end heal, ⚑2 shield magnitude, ⚑3 cadence tuple). The nominal RED convergence is entirely blind-side: four of six S5 failures are blind-fixture bugs (a 5-unit comp assumption against a 4-unit controlComp, and crown monopolizing the B2 slot so poli casts zero bursts — the precise hazard S2b pre-registered), one is a block-shape divergence the driver's encoding wins on the prose ('self AND 2 other'), and one upholds a documented UNMODELED that S6's own flag endorses. The two highest-value traps on this kit were both avoided: the Police-Badge gate stayed bound to the Indomitability line only (the 44.55% aura fires on every later cast), and the burst aura is burstCast-keyed, not fullBurstEnter-keyed — each pinned by a RED counterfactual in the driver's suite, which also isolates the SG pellet-vs-pull hitCount:50 question in both directions. What must change for GO: nothing. Same-model residual for owner spot-check: (1) hitCount:50 rests on the guilty SG convention + engine code, not a poli-specific measurement — ⚑3's rounds/min + reload-gap read from any poli focus video is the cheap independent confirmation; (2) the burst shared-shield allies-vs-self fan-out and the prose-40-vs-datamine-22.27 magnitude are inert today but become live the day a shield-consumer teammate joins a graded comp — worth a popup/HUD check then; (3) the interval first-fire phase (t=20 vs t=0) remains the standing convention flag.
